features.description:
Teach `_parse_audit_response()` in `scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/completion_dispatch.py` to extract the final assistant text / JSON payload from codex's JSONL streaming output, while preserving the existing raw-JSON path. Add fixture-driven tests using the captured codex transcript from the parent dogfood (parent plan `2026-05-06-003-…`, closed at `616ad94`).

## Implementation strategy (per D002)

1. New helper function `_extract_codex_streaming_payload(response: str) -> str | None`. Walks lines of `response`; for each line, attempts `json.loads`. Skips lines that don't parse. Among those that parse, finds events where `event.get('type') == 'item.completed'` AND `event.get('item', {}).get('type') == 'agent_message'`; extracts `event['item']['text']`. Returns the LAST such text (multiple agent_messages → use last; codex emits a final one). Returns `None` if no qualifying event found OR if the input doesn't look like a stream (zero parseable lines).
2. In `_parse_audit_response()`: call `_extract_codex_streaming_payload(response)` FIRST. If it returns a non-None text, use that as the new `cleaned` candidate. If `None`, fall through to the existing `_strip_code_fence` path unchanged.
3. The rest of the function (strip-fence, json.loads, schema validate, dispatch_response_malformed fallback) stays exactly as it is. Streaming detection is purely an INPUT TRANSFORM at the top.

## Fixture (per D003)

Copy the captured transcript bytes from `docs/plans/2026-05-06-003-fix-live-cross-vendor-goal-audit-dogfood/evidence/g-mirror/synthetic-plan/evidence/goal-governance/post_impl/audit/audit-codex-1.transcript.txt` to `scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/tests/fixtures/codex_stream_dogfood_001.txt`. The fixture is OWNED BY the test dir so future cleanup of parent plan dirs doesn't break this test.

## Edge cases to test (per D002 + acceptance bar)

- Streaming envelope with no agent_message item → return None (parser falls through to raw-JSON path → dispatch_response_malformed if raw path also fails).
- Multiple agent_message items in one stream → use the LAST one's text.
- agent_message text is itself fenced JSON (```json...```) → strip-fence logic still applies in the existing path.
- Empty / whitespace-only agent_message text → treat as None; fall through.
- Mid-stream line is malformed JSON → skip, continue scanning (don't abort).
- Non-streaming raw-JSON input (e.g. test stub) → streaming detection returns None, falls through to existing raw-JSON path. Existing tests (incl. `test_production_path_invokes_resolved_executor`) must continue to pass unchanged.
- Streaming envelope where the agent_message text validates against `FindingDisposition` schema (the dogfood case) → parser succeeds; envelope status is the natural agree/disagree from dispositions; status='dispatch_response_malformed' no longer fires for this case.

features.acceptance: (1) `completion_dispatch._parse_audit_response()` recognizes codex's JSONL streaming protocol and extracts `agent_message` `text` as the JSON disposition payload. (2) Streaming-format detection runs FIRST; on no-match falls through to the existing `_strip_code_fence` + raw-JSON path; existing path is unchanged. (3) Fixture `scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/tests/fixtures/codex_stream_dogfood_001.txt` exists with the captured-from-dogfood transcript bytes. (4) New test reads the fixture; parser produces the full 14-disposition list (12 v1 finding_ids F2C-E001..F2C-E012 + 2 auditor-overlay items) with correct `agree` / `severity_disposition` values; envelope status reflects the agree/disagree from those dispositions, NOT `dispatch_response_malformed`. (5) New edge-case tests cover: no agent_message in stream → fall-through; multiple agent_messages → use last; fenced agent_message text; empty agent_message text → fall-through; mid-stream malformed JSON line → skipped not aborted; raw-JSON input (regression for backward compat). (6) Existing `test_production_path_invokes_resolved_executor` and all prior tests pass unchanged. (7) Cumulative orchestrate suite green; ruff + sanitization clean. (8) Worktree boundary preserved (D007): diff confined to completion_dispatch.py + test_completion_dispatch.py + new fixture file + this plan dir. Zero diffs to F001/F003 module code, F1 surface, runtime_evidence/, executors/, cli.py, supervisor.py, agent-conventions schemas, parent plan dirs. (9) NO live codex invocation in the implementation commit. (10) NO prompt template diff in this plan unless explicitly justified by parser-test failure that no parser-only fix can resolve (D006 release valve; default expectation: parser fix is sufficient). (11) Plan-level close via exempt-plan flow exits 0; supervisor backstop silent on the post-close plan. (12) Close-out memo + D-entry appended.
